newsitem.title: USA: Paul Harris May same-store sales up 7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Paul Harris May same-store sales up 7 pct.

text.p: Paul Harris Stores Inc, a specialty retailer of moderately-priced sportswear and accessories, said Thursday its comparable store sales in May rose seven percent from the same period a year ago.
Total sales increased nine percent to $14 million from $12.9 million in May 1996.
For the year to date, comparable store sales were up nine percent and total sales of $57.9 million were up 10 percent compared with $52.5 million last year.
Paul Harris operates 222 stores located in 26 states and the District of Columbia.
